description: Create a one-time upload page for the user's model file, for when the user has the file (attached in chat or on their device) and you cannot pass its contents to get_print_quote. Give the user upload_url; when they say it is uploaded, call get_print_quote with upload_id. Accepts STL, 3MF or zip up to 500 MB (large models are simplified automatically for pricing). The link is valid for 24 hours.
name: create_upload_link
